name: Aoibashi Hazuki
source:
Hazuki, a beautiful and innocent girl with a reason for deciding to appear in an adult video. Voiced by: Takechiyo

A woman who lost her parents at a young age and grew up in an orphanage with her younger siblings. She is currently 20 years old and a virgin with no experience in the adult video industry. Although she has normal sexual knowledge, she has never been interested in sex. In need of money, she persuades the protagonist to visit the office of a brand that specializes in orgies.

She had never been particularly interested in sex before.
She has average sexual knowledge.
She needed money, so she visited the office with no hesitation.
